nativeDescription: The official HERDR interface. Close this view to return to the workbench; the Session and its processes keep running.
nativeCopyHelp: Default keys: Ctrl+B, then [ for Copy mode; / or ? to search; n/N for next/previous; v selects; y copies; Esc exits a mode. Ctrl+B, then ? shows your configured shortcuts.
nativeDetached: The HERDR client detached. Close this view to return to the workbench.
nativeOutputLimit: Output exceeded the renderer queue limit. Close and reopen the Session view to resynchronize.
refreshFailed: Operation completed, but the view could not refresh. Do not repeat the operation.
title: HERDR actions
titleNoSession: HERDR actions (select a Session in the sidebar first)
description: Pick what you want to do. Actions run on the host and Session shown below.
name: Name
worktreeHint: Create an isolated checkout and a new Space for it in the repository of the Space you pick.
pathHint: Optional path on this host. Leave blank for HERDR's worktree directory.
removeWorktreeWarning: This removes the checkout and closes its HERDR Space and running processes. The Git branch remains. Dirty checkouts are refused.
forceWorktreeWarning: Force removal deletes this checkout, including uncommitted changes, and closes its running processes. The Git branch remains.
startAgentHint: Choose an existing shell Pane. HERDR checks that it is available before starting an agent.
argumentsHint: One argument per line; values are passed directly without shell evaluation.
promptHint: HERDR validates the pane's live agent. Prompts do not answer an existing approval or question dialog.
sessionHostHint: The new Session belongs to the host selected above. Existing saved Sessions are preserved.
stopSessionWarning: Stop {{name}} and all of its panes and processes? Its saved layout remains available for restart.
deleteSessionWarning: Delete the saved state of {{name}}? Its saved layout will be removed. This does not delete project folders.
integrationHint: Integrations report lifecycle or native conversation identity. Restart the affected agent after an installation or update.
integrationWarning: Update {{name}}'s HERDR integration configuration on this host?
integrationRemoveWarning: Remove {{name}}'s HERDR integration from this host?
pluginHint: Plugins run commands on the selected host. Installation and enabled state are shared by that host's Sessions.
pluginWarning: Install {{source}} on this host? Its declared build and runtime commands run with your account permissions. Continue only if you trust this source.
pluginRemoveWarning: Unregister {{name}} and remove its HERDR-managed checkout? Locally linked source files are retained.
unavailable: This running HERDR version does not expose the required operation.
working: Working… Waits can take up to two minutes. Requests are not retried.
agentStartPending: The agent is starting. Wait until it is ready before sending a prompt.
